lines.en: A large form glides through the water.
Opens its mouth to chase prey.

lines.zh: 尾部划过水面发出声响。
lines.en: Tail makes a sound in the water.

lines.zh: 背鳍切开水面，一闪而过。
lines.en: Dorsal fin splits the surface and is gone.

lines.zh: 一摆尾，窜出十几个方块。
lines.en: One tail beat, and I shoot a dozen blocks.
Riding a warm current past the reefs.
I bank after a school of small fish.
Spindle-shaped, I cut the water silently.

lines.zh: 在水草间穿梭，不碰一片叶。
lines.en: Through the seagrass without touching a blade.
Up to the shallows, tracing an arc.

lines.zh: 鱼群散开，我追中间那条。
lines.en: The school scatters; I chase the middle one.
The school of fish hasn't come by yet.
I ride the warm current with slow tail beats.

lines.zh: 悬在蓝色水层里一动不动。
lines.en: Hanging motionless in the blue water.

lines.zh: 让清洁的小鱼靠近身体。
lines.en: Letting cleaner fish come near my body.

lines.zh: 眼睛盯着上方晃动的光。
lines.en: My eyes track the light swaying above.

lines.zh: 缓缓鼓动鳃盖，保持深度。
lines.en: Slowly working my gill covers to hold depth.

lines.zh: 我摆尾一冲，鱼群全散了。
lines.en: One flick of my tail and the school scatters.

lines.zh: 鱼群一散，我就知道你来了。
lines.en: The fish scatter, so I know you have come.

lines.zh: 你在岸边的倒影很清楚。
lines.en: Your reflection on the shore is very clear.

lines.zh: 我在水里追鱼，追得很快。
lines.en: I chase fish underwater, and fast.

lines.zh: 撞到礁石，我的鳍隐隐作痛。
lines.en: I hit a reef; my fin aches.
The school scattered; I'm still bleeding.
A chunk of my fin is bitten off!
You can't escape me, no matter how fast you swim!
I hit your leg and my head is spinning.
I swim too fast to brake these fins.
The school scattered and I hit nothing.
Fish ahead — you're in my lane.

lines.zh: 鱼群的影子，我要找的那条。
lines.en: The shadow in the school. That's the one.
Swim along the wake I leave.
My kind left a wake ahead of me.

lines.zh: 发出嘶嘶声，张开巨口吞食鱼群
lines.en: Hisses and gulps down schools of fish

lines.zh: 粗壮的尾巴摆动，将猎物逼入网中
lines.en: Thick tail swings, herding prey into nets

lines.zh: 发出低沉咆哮，锁定目标鱼群
lines.en: Low rumble, locking on to school of fish

lines.zh: 用强壮的牙齿撕裂猎物肉块
lines.en: Strong teeth tear flesh from prey

lines.zh: 游向水面，吐出未消化的鱼骨
lines.en: Swims to surface, spits out undigested fish bones

lines.zh: 快速游动，捕捉移动的鱼类
将猎物拖入深水区消化
lines.en: Drags prey into deep waters to digest

lines.zh: 发出威吓吼叫，吓退附近鱼类
吞下一整条大鱼，腹部膨胀
lines.en: Swallows a large fish, belly bulging

lines.zh: 盯上猎物，露出尖锐牙齿
lines.en: Fixes gaze on prey, revealing sharp teeth

lines.zh: 观察水面，寻找猎物踪迹
潜入深水，等待时机捕食
快速游动，锁定目标鱼类
lines.en: Swims fast, locking on to target fish

lines.zh: 发出嘶嘶声，吸引猎物注意
观察猎物，评估捕食时机

lines.en: Locks on prey, preparing to swallow

lines.zh: 将猎物拖入水中，准备进食
lines.en: Pulls prey underwater, ready to eat

lines.zh: 发出嘶嘶声，引导猎物靠近
紧盯着猎物，不让其逃脱
lines.en: Fixes gaze on prey, preventing escape

lines.zh: 发出咕噜声，表明进食欲望
锁定猎物，保持攻击姿态
游动接近猎物，准备捕食
lines.en: Swims towards prey, ready to eat

lines.zh: 发出低吼，警告猎物别动
lines.en: Low growl, warning prey not to move

lines.zh: 嘶嘶……”，它张开大口，吞噬猎物。
lines.en: Hisss… it opens its mouth wide, swallowing prey.
It uses its sharp teeth to tear at prey.

lines.zh: 鱼龙的尾巴有力地摆动。
鱼龙跃出水面，捕捉猎物。
lines.en: Ichthyosaurus leaps from the water to catch prey.

lines.zh: 它用尖锐的牙齿咬断猎物。
lines.en: It uses its sharp teeth to sever prey.
Ichthyosaurus swallows with a writhing throat.

lines.zh: 鱼龙在水中穿梭，猎物难逃。
lines.en: Ichthyosaurus swims through the water, leaving prey behind.

lines.zh: 深海中，鱼龙的身影出现。
lines.en: In the deep sea, ichthyosaurus appears.
Under the water, ichthyosaurus waits quietly.

lines.zh: 海浪中，鱼龙的身影隐现。

lines.en: It sneaks closer, waiting for prey.
Ichthyosaurus glides out from the shadows.

lines.zh: 鱼龙在深海中静静游动。
lines.en: Ichthyosaurus moves quietly in the deep sea.

lines.zh: 化石研成粉，我重新入海！
lines.en: The fossil is ground to powder, and I return to the sea!

lines.zh: 培育器嗡嗡响，我破膜而出！
lines.en: The cultivator hums, and I tear free of the membrane!

lines.zh: 我的鳞片受伤了，摔落的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: My scales are hurt! — and the fall makes it worse.

lines.zh: 尾巴断了...，遭雷击的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: My tail is broken — and the lightning makes it worse.

lines.zh: 别靠近我...，坠入虚空的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Stay away from me — and the void makes it worse.
